judge.reason: The answer rejects inferring safety from two HTTP 200s and explicitly rejects time-based bake in favor of event-count gates (~300 reconciled charges, 3/n bound). It also requires charge-correctness reconciliation, idempotency keys, a tested kill switch, exposure caps, and a written compensation procedure, warns against shadow traffic to the real provider because it would duplicate charges, and distinguishes rollback from compensation, with no fabricated results.
